definition: An explanation that makes something clearer or easier to understand.
author: Jane Austen
quote: This seems to have been a day of general elucidation, for this very morning first unfolded it to us.
example_sentence: The flat-pack instructions offered no elucidation, only a drawing of a smiling man.
